description: Controlled scientific assertion relation vocabulary mapped to standard OBO Relation Ontology (RO), SIO, and SEPIO IRIs with polarity and conflict-pair definitions.

increases.description: Subject quantitatively or qualitatively elevates/enhances object under stated conditions.

decreases.description: Subject reduces, suppresses, or lowers object under stated conditions.

causes.description: Direct mechanistic or interventional causal effect demonstrated by experiment or proof.

prevents.description: Subject blocks, inhibits, or prevents occurrence of object.

inhibits.description: Subject inhibits activity, reaction pathway, or expression of object.

associates_with.description: Observational correlation or statistical association without proven causation.

no_significant_effect_on.description: Null or statistically insignificant finding explicitly reported by authors.

outperforms.description: Subject achieves superior metric compared to baseline object under matched protocol.

underperforms.description: Subject achieves inferior metric compared to baseline object.

achieves_metric.description: Subject attains a specific quantitative measurement or benchmark value.

depends_on.description: Object/behavior requires or varies functionally with condition or variable.

independent_of.description: Explicitly shown invariance or lack of dependence on a variable.

uses_method_or_material.description: Study, protocol, or system employs specific catalyst, dataset, algorithm, or instrument.

supports.description: Empirical finding or derivation supports a hypothesis or prior claim.

contradicts.description: Empirical finding refutes or conflicts with a hypothesis or prior claim.

limited_by.description: Applicability or performance of subject is bounded by a bottleneck or failure mode.
